name: MSFT synthetic release paired fixture v2

question: 只使用本轮合成资料核对 MSFT 持仓、计划及买入理由。列出股数、单位成本、总成本、市值、币种内持仓权重和 MA5/20/60。分别说明交易日期、手记版本时间、交易理由版本时间、最后收盘时间，初次写作时间能否确定。现金、账户总仓位、席位续费和利润质量缺证时保持未知。回答简短，标明来源和时间。
review_criteria: The independent trading quote equals the final synthetic close, but their field meanings stay distinct.
Check quantity, cost, value and SMA calculations against frozen expected values and calculation parents.
Note version applies to that note only; the trade-reason version and first writing time remain unknown.
Weight 1 covers the observed USD holdings only; cash and account-wide weight remain unknown.
Quotes and moving averages do not establish enterprise renewals or profit quality.
Record engine-specific budgets and reasoning effort; retain previous findings without replay.
